_comment: Phase 1 (ideal model) shared parameter file. Owner: A. Read by B (scene + candidate RIS sites), C (channel format, noise, thresholds), D (paper tables). All lengths in metres, angles in degrees, z is height.

rf._noise_note: noise_power_dbm = -174 + 10log10(BW) + NF = -174 + 80 + 9 = -85 dBm (computed in code, value here is for reference)

ris.element_pattern: cos(theta_incidence) power pattern per element, zero behind the surface (cos<0)

scene._blockage_note: Any link (BS-UE, BS-RIS, RIS-UE) whose straight segment crosses a building box gets a flat 40 dB penalty (mmWave penetration/diffraction proxy). RIS-link blockage is evaluated at the RIS centre. B should use the SAME footprints/heights and the same candidate sites.

ris_orientations._note: Normal = (cos(tilt)cos(az), cos(tilt)sin(az), -sin(tilt)). az=0 points along +x (away from the BS).

metrics._note: coverage = fraction of UE grid points with SNR >= threshold. Best placement = highest mean coverage over all four N (tie-break: mean SNR).

keys.hd: complex64 [U]       BS->UE direct channel (amplitude incl. antenna gains + blockage, phase = -2*pi*d/lambda)
keys.hr: complex64 [N]       BS->RIS channel per element (incl. BS gain, element gain/pattern, blockage)
keys.g: complex64 [U, N]    RIS->UE channel per element (incl. UE gain, element pattern, blockage)
keys.ideal_snr_db: float32 [U] SNR with ideal continuous phases (for sanity checks)

channel_file_format.snr_formula: gamma[u] = Pt * |hd[u] + sum_n hr[n] * exp(j*theta[u,n]) * g[u,n]|^2 / sigma2   (theta is chosen per UE)
channel_file_format.note_for_B_and_C: B: write files with exactly these keys (U,N may differ). C: use channel_io.py (load_channels, ideal_phase, snr_db) so rounding code works on A's and B's files identically.
